Title: Cyrena.APIReferences - Solution Architecture
Content:
## Solution Purpose
Cyrena.APIReferences is a Blazor Component Library extension for the Cyréna AI assistant framework. It provides:
1. A CRUD UI for managing API Reference documents (authoritative technical documentation)
2. A Semantic Kernel plugin exposing API Reference operations as AI-callable functions
3. Persistence of API Reference data via Cyrena.Persistence.Core

## Architecture

### Extension Entry Point
- `DocumentsExtension` extends `Cyrena.Extensa.Models.Extension` (from Cyrena.Extensa.Core)
- Calls `builder.AddApiReferencePages()` during `BuildExtension`
- Extension ID: `cyrena.api_references`
- Depends on: `cyrena.developer` (min version 0.4.0)

### Public API Surfaces
1. `DocumentsExtension` - IExtension implementation for Extensa loader
2. `CyrenaBuilderExtensions.AddApiReferencePages()` - Registers the extension's plugin and Blazor assembly
3. `ApiReference` - Entity model for API reference documents
4. `ApiReferenceSearch` - Search result DTO
5. `ApiReferenceSummary` - Summary DTO
6. Blazor Pages: `Index.razor` (list), `Edit.razor` (create/edit)

### Internal Services
- `AssistantPlugin` (internal) - IAssistantPlugin that:
  - Registers `IStore<ApiReference>` as singleton
  - Adds `APIReferences` Semantic Kernel plugin
  - Adds toolbar component (ToolbarIcon - currently MISSING from codebase)
  - Only loads in `DevelopOptions.AssistantModeId` mode

- `APIReferences` (internal) - Semantic Kernel plugin with functions:
  - `search` - keyword-based search with scoring
  - `all` - list all references
  - `read` - read full document content
  - `create` - create new reference
  - `update` - update existing reference
  - `delete` - delete reference

### Data Model
`ApiReference` extends `Entity` (from Cyrena.Core) and implements `IJsonSerializable`:
- Title (required)
- Keywords[]
- Summary
- Link (optional file linkage)
- Content (markdown/plaintext technical documentation)

### Dependencies
- Cyrena.Components.Core - Blazor UI contracts
- Cyrena.Extensa.Core - Extension system
- Cyrena.Persistence.Core - Data persistence
- Cyrena.Coding.Core - Provides DevelopOptions.AssistantModeId and CodeInput component

### Known Gaps
- `ToolbarIcon` component referenced in AssistantPlugin.cs but does not exist in Components/Shared
- `CodeInput` component used in Edit.razor but defined in external Cyrena.Coding.Core
- `DevelopOptions` used for mode filtering but defined in external Cyrena.Coding.Core
